description: LearnCard badge issuer. We use this for our Accounting courses (the ACCY-* subjects). The Pretend Association of Accountants partners with LearnCard, so badges issued here reach their employer members. This runs first for any credential we send out — it's the only issuer we have — and it's normally paired with the LearnCard wallet target so the learner also gets the badge in their wallet.
eligibility_notes: Select for Accounting (ACCY-*) course and skill events that should produce a badge. Pair with learncard_wallet. Not the right target for Finance (FINC-*) events — those go to SmartResume.

description: Delivers the issued badge into the learner's LearnCard wallet for long-term storage and sharing. Goes together with the LearnCard issuer for our Accounting (ACCY-*) courses, under the Pretend Association of Accountants / LearnCard partnership. It delivers the issued badge, so it only makes sense when learncard_issuer was also selected.
eligibility_notes: Select alongside learncard_issuer for Accounting (ACCY-*) events where the learner has a resolvable LearnCard wallet profile (recipient_profile_id in the learner context). Not on its own without the issuer.

description: SmartResume delivery. We use this for our Finance courses (the FINC-* subjects). The Pretend Association of Finance partners with SmartResume, so Finance credentials are delivered there for their members. The LearnCard issuer still runs first (it's our only issuer); this target just changes the final delivery step to SmartResume instead of the LearnCard wallet.
eligibility_notes: Select for Finance (FINC-*) course and skill events. Normally mutually exclusive with learncard_wallet for a given event — Accounting routes to LearnCard, Finance routes to SmartResume — though an institution could configure both.
